summary_1line: Ghatotkacha slays Alayudha and devastates the Kaurava army with illusions until Karna, pressed by panic, finally uses Indra’s divine dart against him.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ghatotkacha, gigantic and blood‑covered, roars while holding the severed head of the demon Alayudha before the armies.
A sky of red storm clouds created by Ghatotkacha rains blazing weapons and rocks upon the terrified Kaurava army below.
Karna, surrounded by fleeing soldiers in the night battle, raises Indra’s blazing divine dart to hurl at the towering Ghatotkacha.
